businessGoals.name: Reliable Transfers
businessGoals.description: Execute money transfers between accounts safely and atomically

domainConcepts.name: Transfer
domainConcepts.description: Movement of funds from one account to another

domainConcepts.name: Transfer Limit
domainConcepts.description: Maximum amount that can be transferred in a single transaction

rules.description: Source account must have sufficient funds for the transfer
Source and destination accounts must be different
Daily transfer limit is the sum of all transfers made by the source account on the current day
A completed transfer cannot be modified

buildingBlocks.name: Transfer
buildingBlocks.description: Aggregate root representing a money transfer between two accounts

behaviours.name: initiate
behaviours.description: Initiates a new transfer between two accounts

behaviours.name: complete
behaviours.description: Marks the transfer as completed after funds are moved

buildingBlocks.name: AccountId
buildingBlocks.description: Unique identifier for an account. Already exists in the project.

buildingBlocks.name: Amount
buildingBlocks.description: Monetary amount. Already exists in the project.

buildingBlocks.name: TransferStatus
buildingBlocks.description: Enum representing transfer lifecycle: Initiated, Completed, Failed

buildingBlocks.name: TransferInitiated
buildingBlocks.description: Emitted when a transfer is initiated

buildingBlocks.name: TransferCompleted
buildingBlocks.description: Emitted when a transfer is completed successfully

buildingBlocks.name: TransferRepository
buildingBlocks.description: Repository for persisting and retrieving Transfer aggregates

behaviours.name: findById
behaviours.description: Finds a transfer by its id

useCases.name: Initiate Transfer
useCases.description: Account holder initiates a transfer from their account to another

scenarios.name: Successful transfer initiation
scenarios.description: Transfer between two different accounts with sufficient funds
scenarios.given: Source account with balance 1000 and destination account
scenarios.then: Transfer is created with Initiated status and TransferInitiated event is emitted

scenarios.name: Transfer to same account rejected
scenarios.description: Cannot transfer to the same account
scenarios.when: Account holder tries to transfer to the same account
